steps.title: Meet the requester
steps.say: I am signed in as the requester. I will create a request, switch to the approver, and show the result.

steps.title: Describe the request
steps.say: I enter a short description and a justification. Watch the fields fill in before I submit.

steps.title: Submit for approval
steps.say: The request is now submitted. The status changes to Awaiting approval.

steps.title: Review and approve
steps.say: I switch to the approver role. Here is the request and its justification. I approve it, and the status updates.

steps.title: Show the final result
steps.say: Back in the requester view, the request is approved. This concludes the walkthrough.
